title: Reviewers for Journal of Insect Science (November 2023–October 2024)
content: The Editor-in-Chief and the Subject Editors of the Journal of Insect Science thank the following scientists for their voluntary commitment of valuable professional time and expertise to peer-reviewing manuscripts submitted for publication in our journal. The quality and scientific stature of the journal depends on the conscientious efforts of these individuals.
